entities.text:
High Court Of Jammu & Kashmir And Ladakh
 At Jammu
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This appeal has been preferred by the appellant against award dated 27.06.2024 passed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Jammu in claim petition filed under Section 166 and 140 of MV Act titled "Shabina Shah and Ors. Vs. State of J & K through Director General of Police and Anr"
thereby awarding compensation to the tune of Rs. 27,48,214/- in favour of respondents along with interest @7.5% per annum.

entities.text: Shabina Shah and Ors. Vs. State of J & K
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Issue notice to the respondents, returnable within four weeks, subject to taking of requisite steps for service within one week.

Meanwhile, subject to deposit of Rs. 15 lacs before the Registrar Judicial of this Court within a period of four weeks, impugned award dated 27.06.2024 shall remain stayed and the amount on its deposit shall be kept in FDR initially for a period of six months.

(Moksha Khajuria Kazmi) Judge JAMMU 30.12.2025 Manik Ut Of J & K vs Shabina Shah And Ors on 30 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113187315/
